➢ How do I read this sheet?

7
Team Compositions

8
➢ Teams are simply arranged based on Trekker release order.
➢ The first Trekker listed in each team composition is always considered the Main Slot Trekker.
➢ The second Trekker is usually the primary Support Slot Trekker.
➢ The remaining Trekkers are candidates for the final Support Slot, listed in order of their effectiveness for the team.
➢ Trekkers with universal buff effect will not be included unless they offer exceptional value as an alternative option. This is done to reduce the clutter with how much team compositions there are.

*Exception:
- Some team compositions require both Support Slot Trekkers as mandatory picks. In these cases, only the last listed Trekker is flexible and may be swapped out if they are needed for another team.

9
Main Discs

10
Main Disc priorities are determined by overall team utility with these specific Crescendo criteria in mind:

• C1 for Limited, Standard, and Finale Echoing Discs
• C6 for Cataclysm and Event Discs

About Support Discs
You will usually choose Discs that provide the highest relevant stat for the team. Of course, it is best if it also matches the note requirements of your Main Discs but only think of this when we have more Disc options.

Typically, the stats you are looking for are:
• Base ATK
• Elemental DMG%
• AA/Skill DMG%

11
Emblems

12
➢ All emblem affixes are based on the highest rarity.
➢ Emblem affixes with GREEN background indicate that they are the best emblem affix to go for in that slot.
➢ Affixes are ordered by priority from most important (top) to least important (bottom).
➢ Having an Elemental PEN stat of any rarity for your DPS is always better than having none, but do not lock PEN below Gold or Rainbow rarity.

13
Potentials

14
➢ The recommendations are based on maxed out Monolith Research and Ascension Difficulty 8.
➢ All Potentials are arranged based on acquisition and level upgrade priority.
➢ Level 1: Safe to not upgrade past the base level
➢ Level 1+: Upgrade the Potential as much as you can if possible
➢ Level 6: Always upgrade the Potential to its maximum level

*For specific questions, go to the #help-and-advice channel of Stella Sora Official server.

27
Wraith (5★) | 1+/10/1/1+ (Main Skill >>> Auto Attack > Ultimate)

28

Wraith's Auto Attack build utilizes her melee mode to summon tornados with Last Gasp of Gale and Twin Shadows.

To maximize the amount of tornados that she can summon, do the Main Skill x1 -> Auto Attack -> Main Skill x1 -> Auto Attack rotation. This will allow her to consistently summon and maintain 3 tornados against the enemy,

★ Key Notes:
• Unlike other compositions, this team thrives on maximizing Melody of Focus notes, since Blade's Waltz, Zero Hour, and Rapid Draw scale poorly with more levels by comparison.

Whirling Onslaught (Main Skill) is the main priority to level up for this build since Last Gasp of Gale and Twin Shadows scale with its level.

29

Swish and Fire (Auto Attack) is the second priority, although you can take your time with it as the damage it can contribute is not that much and nothing scales based on its level.

30

Thousand Shade Dance (Ultimate) is the lowest priority since, at most, she can only use it thrice and does not leave that much of an impact compared to the rest.

Ann (4★) | 1/1/10/1 (Support Skill only)

45

Ann supports the team by giving a lot of Ventus DMG Taken debuffs and ATK% buffs.

★ Key Notes:
• Warm Wind Guard requires you to enter directly into the wall and can be unreliable at certain situations. If you find it difficult to do consistently, you can opt to replace it with Gale Bastion.
• Both Turbulent Flow and Wind Erosion Havoc requires the enemy to be within the wall.

Wind Barrier (Support Skill) provides the team with an ATK% buff that scales based on the skill's level so it is recommended to level this skill.
